title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES AUTHORIZING THE COLLECTION OF VOLUNTARY CONTRIBUTIONS OF FIVE, TEN, AND TWENTY CENTAVOS FROM PUPILS AND STUDENTS ENROLLED IN PUBLIC AND PRIVATE ELE- MENTARY, SECONDARY, AND COLLEGIATE SCHOOLS, RESPECTIVELY, WITH WHICH TO FINANCE THE REPAIR OR RECONSTRUCTION OF THE HOUSE OCCUPIED BY DR. JOSE RIZAL IN CALAMBA, LAGUNA, AND OF DAPITAN PARK IN ZAMBOANGA.

text.en:
1788
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
contributions in the amounts of five centavos from every
elementary school pupil, ten centavos from every second-
ary school student, and twenty centavos from every colle-
giate student enrolled in the public and private schools,
the proceeds from said collection to be used for the repair
or reconstruction of the house occupied by Dr. Jose Rizal
in Calamba, Laguna, and of Dapitan Park in Zamboanga.:
Done in the City of Manila this 19th day of June, in the
year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-eight, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the second.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
EMILIO ABELLO
Executive Secretary
